title: Recover saved campaign records without losing your place
description: History envoy returns to a waiting development campaign, reads beyond the first page, receives another device’s changes without forced scrolling, explicitly recovers latest records, and restores the same selected system. Setup uses real UI and services with a test-only fixed catalogue input; keys, commands and persistence remain real.

steps.description: Prepare a fixed-catalogue waiting campaign through ordinary sign-in/create/join UI, then twelve acknowledged host pause/resume actions. These establish existing history, not a claim of illustrated admission or hosted scheduling.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open ten saved records with the return control visible.
verifications: The history dialog offers briefing and an always-visible return control.

steps.description: Traverse the briefing, return control and bounded records with the keyboard.
steps.acknowledgement: Focus returns to the bounded records after both modal wrap directions.
verifications: The return rail is still visible before any scrolling.

steps.description: Expand record 14 to read the saved roster.
steps.acknowledgement: The selected record reveals the saved commander.
verifications: Expanding a record preserves all ten loaded revisions.

steps.description: Load earlier records beyond the ten-record page boundary.
verifications: The beginning of authorized history is reached.

steps.description: Open the same commander’s second authenticated device through its campaign URL; no account or game state is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Pause the campaign on another device while preserving the reading device’s place.
steps.acknowledgement: The host command is acknowledged as paused.
verifications: The reading device signals new records without replacing its thirteen records or scrolling.

steps.description: Choose latest records and recover acknowledged revision 15.
steps.acknowledgement: Record 15 is present from persisted campaign history.
verifications: The current history page contains ten records.

steps.description: Disconnect both devices to exercise recovery; this is an explicit browser-network fault.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Request latest records offline and retain readable saved history.
verifications: All ten previously loaded records remain readable.

steps.description: Restore the browser network before the explicit player retry.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Retry history after reconnecting and clear the recovery error.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovery error clears and latest records becomes available.
verifications: Revision 15 remains the acknowledged latest record.

steps.description: Close history with Escape and return to the same selected system.
steps.acknowledgement: The opening History control receives focus.

steps.description: Reload and recover the same saved latest record.
steps.acknowledgement: Persisted record 15 is recovered after reload.

steps.description: Use Return to galaxy to finish reading after reload.
steps.acknowledgement: The history dialog closes and returns focus to its opening control.
verifications: The selected system still matches the previous visit.
